entities.summary: Evgeny Gladskikh is a Russian ice hockey player who is currently playing for Torpedo Nizhny Novgorod in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He was selected by Vancouver Canucks in the 4th round of the 2001 NHL Entry Draft.
